goal: I retain this as my historical plan to prove that my preserved32 client and new64 client encode exactly the same network wire contracts expected by unchangedServer19; I qualify internal native layouts separately.

procedure.name: Native architecture and typedef proof
requirements: I wait for the actual native build exit and an explicit compiler budget.
I compile separate real Win32 and AMD64 consoles and preserve the original runners and generated outputs.
I assert actual PE I386 vs AMD64 and sizeof(void*)4 vs8, WORD2/DWORD4/WCHAR2/HOBJECT4/TBLIDX4/ITEMID8.
I use real shared protocol headers with both relevant client/server include orders, without a packet-struct facade or a changed PACKET_MAX_SIZE.

procedure.name: Complete protocol fingerprints
requirements: I generate opcode numeric values and sizeof for all BEGIN_PROTOCOL structs and BEGIN_PROTOCOL_IDENTITY aliases in the selected headers.
I emit offsetof and array element sizes for critical auth/character/enterworld/item/coupon/SortV1/SortV2 payloads.
I compare both JSON fingerprints exactly and fail on any opcode, packing, signedness, size or field-offset mismatch.
I assert StackSort Move25, ClientMove10, MaxItems160 and every new fixed/dynamic wire frame at or below4095.

procedure.name: Byte-level golden packets
requirements: I zero-initialize and fill real structs deterministically, without raw pointers or test accounts.
I cover token0xFEDCBA9876543210, handles/tblidx high32, signed option values0/INT_MAX/INT_MIN/-1, multilingualWCHAR2 fields, stack donor deletion and retainedcount/cap.
I compare serialized Win32/AMD64 byte streams and lengths exactly, including V1 compatibility and complete160-entry V2 frames.
I keep Known/Unknown persistence errors and invalid token/count/frame cases fail-closed.

procedure.name: Production-path regression
requirements: I port exact-header packet-data-contract and inventory-stack-sort-client23-v2 bodies to AMD64 variants without deleting or weakening the original32 assertions.
I exercise the actual packet GetPacketData BYTE* contract, checked framing/length, one SendPacket call and its preserved return.
I re-run coupon exact-lock/correlation, shared loader option-value/ownership, and current client Sort callback/reentrancy cases only after reviewing the architecture adapters.
I require no databaseDML, service restart, game login or live network test for these ABI consoles.

separate_limits: I do not interpret passing protocol ABI as certification of gameplay, GUI, GPU, native DFF streams, BVL64 or long-session memory.
I do not carry over Win32 internal class size100/audio,5112/actor or facadeCombo44 as expected AMD64 sizes.
I did not invoke a native compiler to produce this plan.
